title: shot-sparsity-entropy-jotter
body:
Purpose / sketch
- Quick personal notebook exploring how shot sparsity (very small few-shot sets) and exemplar entropy affect model stability across generations. Looking for heuristics to pick 1-4 exemplar shots for production prompt libraries.

Context / why this matters
- Production billing + latency push to minimize few-shot tokens. Some customers run 512-token budgets or less; we want stable outputs with cheaper prompt patterns.
- Observed brittle behavior when 1) exemplar diversity is low (redundant shots) or 2) exemplar entropy is high (contradictory phrasing).

High-level hypotheses
1) Sparse, high-salience anchor + 1 low-noise paraphrase beats 4 noisy diverse shots for extraction tasks.
2) For creative tasks (summarization+tone), higher shot entropy improves variety but reduces deterministic alignment — need post-filtering or temperature control.
3) Place the exemplar with lowest lexical overlap last (recency priming) to nudge final style.

Quick experiments ran (notes)
- Model: open-llama-13b-quant (hosted dev). t=0.2 for extraction, t=0.7 for summarization tests.
- Task A: invoice line-item extraction (structured). Prompt variants: 0-shot, 1-anchor, 2-anchor (redundant), 3-diverse. Metrics: exact-match on keys, token budget.
  - 0-shot: fast but 32% EM, hallucinated totals.
  - 1-anchor (canonical input -> canonical output): 71% EM.
  - 2-anchor (two near-identical anchors): 69% EM (worse than 1).
  - 3-diverse: 74% EM but more variance across receipts with odd layouts.
  => Note: redundancy hurts; diversity helps but increases variance. Try 1-anchor + tiny schema hint instead of extra shot.

- Task B: product description rewrite (brand voice). Prompt variants: 1-shot high-entropy (different styles), 2-shot consistent, 3-shot anchored+variation. Human eval (quick): perceived brand match score (1-5).
  - 1-high-entropy: mean 3.1, high creativity, occasional tone drift.
  - 2-consistent: mean 4.0, safe but repetitive.
  - 3-anchored+var: mean 4.2, best balance but +35 tokens.
  => Tradeoff: tokens vs quality. For affordable SLO, prefer 2-shot consistent with optional n-best rerank.

Failure cases observed (concrete)
- Example: invoice with table rotated/wrapped. Few-shot anchors used clean-line items; model copied wrong columns. Root cause: exemplar distribution mismatch. TODO: add one noisy exemplar with line-wrapping.
- Example: brand voice prompt with expletive in exemplar variant (edge-case in dataset). Model occasionally reproduced strong language even with content filter enabled. Root cause: exemplar left intact; pass-through. Fix: sanitize exemplar library. Add small test scaffold that strips profanity from exemplar text.

Heuristics emerging (working list)
- If target output is high-structure (json, csv): use 1 canonical low-noise anchor + explicit schema block. Avoid multiple near-duplicates.
- If target output is style-focused: prefer 2 consistent exemplars that share lexical anchors (phrases) rather than diverse voices.
- For token-constrained contexts (<120 tokens extra): prefer template + single exemplar; use KV-prefix caching to avoid repeated exemplar tokens across requests.
- When using multiple exemplars, place the exemplar with highest exemplarity (closest to median of dataset) last to exploit recency bias.

Prompt prototypes (scratch)
- Invoice extractor (1-shot anchor + schema):
  Prompt: "Extract items from the invoice below as JSON array of {description, qty, unit_price, total}. If not present, return null for the field. Example:
  INVOICE_EXAMPLE:
  Item: ``Widget A`` Qty: 3 Unit: $12.00 Total: $36.00
  OUTPUT_EXAMPLE: [{\"description\":\"Widget A\",\"qty\":3,\"unit_price\":12.00,\"total\":36.00}]
  ---
  INVOICE_TO_PARSE:
  [INVOICE HERE]
  Return only JSON."
- Brand rewrite (2-shot consistent):
  Prompt: "Rewrite the product copy to be concise and friendly, preserving facts. Tone: upbeat, clever but respectful. Examples:
  1) Input: ... Output: ...
 2) Input: ... Output: ...
  ===
  Now rewrite:
  [SOURCE TEXT]"

Mini-experiments to run next
- Systematic grid over shot count 0..4 x exemplar-entropy (low/med/high) x temp 0.0/0.2/0.6 for two tasks (A structured, B creative). 50 seeds each. Collect: EM / BLEU / human-score proxies.
- Add a noisy exemplar to the structural set to measure robustness to wrapped tables.
- Try last-exemplar recency trick vs first-exemplar anchor.

Notes to self (implementation pointers)
- Build a tiny tool in prompt-tooling to compute 'exemplar entropy' using tokenized unigram entropy across candidate shot set. Use that metric to surface top-k low-entropy exemplars for structural tasks. (See linked PR)
- Pipeline: exemplar-selection service should prefer: freshness -> low-entropy -> dataset-median closeness -> sanitized content.
- Add unit test harness in GH PR for 3 canned receipts that broke before. Automation: run with quantized dev model and hosted prod mirror.

Open questions / risks
- How to measure exemplar representativeness quickly without full eval? (sampling proxy idea: embed centroid distance + token-entropy). Need to validate correlation.
- Does exemplar paraphrasing (synthetic augmentation) reduce hallucination? Maybe, but could increase entropy and hurt structure tasks.

To-do (short)
- [ ] Implement entropy metric prototype (python snippet)
- [ ] Add noise exemplar to structural validation set (3 cases)
- [ ] Sanitize exemplar pool for profanity/PII
- [ ] Experiment last-exemplar recency placement

Scratch code (pseudocode)
- entropy candidate:
  tokens = tokenizer.encode(text)
  p = freq(tokens)/len(tokens)
  H = -sum(p * log2(p))
  return H / log2(len(vocab))  # normalized

Slack notes: ping @marisol for dataset samples; linked Linear ticket for tracking RDWF-3424 (exemplar selection).

Random micro-observations
- Models with strong recency bias (open-llama config) amplify last-shot tone more than expected; might be a shortcut to reduce shots if we can cheaply find the best-last exemplar.
- For some receipt layouts, adding a single negative example ("this is NOT an item line") reduced hallucinated dates. Weird, but maybe negative examples help boundary detection.

End of jotter.
(Will convert to a small RN or notebook once prototype scripts produce reproducible numbers.)
